findings: count_workspace used h both as PL/pgSQL header variable and SQL alias, preventing history reads and therefore browser stock rendering. Rename the SQL alias.
FOUND is not an accepted material-adjustment reason enum. Map the existing human choice to accepted COUNT_CORRECTION and preserve its meaning in notes; do not relax the native constraint.

Native document signature encoded timestamptz with the session offset. Equivalent instants could fail comparison after a timezone change or on another connection. Use epoch in the private signature and explicitly test posting from another timezone.
